description: ui-health uses code-facts (via `CodeFactsService.DescribeCodeFacts`) to determine UI presence and framework, replacing hand-rolled directory and port probing. A scenario with no UI surface produces a clean "no UI surface" report rather than spurious Findings.

requirements.description: ui-health must determine UI presence and framework using code-facts via `CodeFactsService.DescribeCodeFacts`, replacing any hand-rolled directory-existence or port-probing heuristics for detecting a UI surface.
requirements.title: UI presence/framework via code-facts

validation.notes: ui-health calls CodeFactsService.DescribeCodeFacts to determine UI presence and framework
No hand-rolled directory-existence or port-probe heuristic is used to detect the UI surface
Run ui-health against a UI scenario and confirm the detected framework matches the code-facts framework
Code-facts is the single source of truth for UI presence and framework detection

requirements.description: When code-facts report that a scenario has no UI surface, ui-health must produce a clean "no UI surface" report with no spurious Findings and a passing verdict, rather than failing because directories or ports are absent.
requirements.title: Non-UI scenario clean report

validation.notes: A scenario whose code-facts indicate no UI surface yields a report with zero spurious Findings
The no-UI report carries an explicit no-UI-surface status and a passing verdict
Run `ui-health validate scenario <non-ui-scenario> --json` and confirm a clean no-UI-surface report with exit code 0
Non-UI scenarios are never penalized for lacking a UI surface

title: Code-facts-driven UI gating
